review.verdict: First healer on seven bosses, and the only person in Naxxramas killed by something from his own bags
review.summary: On paper a great night: first of the healers on Anub'Rekhan, Grobbulus, Thaddius, Gothik, the Horsemen, Noth and Heigan, and the most healing on the Sapphiron wipe (296k). Then you open the death log. Heigan killed 31 people tonight. The 32nd death on that fight was you, at 2:56, and the killing blow was your own Dark Rune. On Noth, while the curses were going off around you, you were busy losing a fistfight to a Plagued Warrior (1:23). 20 Mana Potions and 8 Dark Runes, the most of any healer by miles, so the rune habit was always going to end like this. Kreeg's Stout Beatdown and Gordok Green Grog on 12 of 14 pulls each, Spirit of Zanza on 2: the tavern has your loyalty, Zanza doesn't.

Then the deaths: Razuvious at 0:49 in the control gap, Chain Lightning on Thaddius at 1:58, the first Eruption death on Heigan at 1:35 with Drikkle, and four on trash (spiders, the Stitched Spewers, the Unholy weapons wipe, Noth's explosions).

fix.text: Four trash deaths.

fix.text: 22nd of 25, Chain Lightning at 1:58.

review.verdict: Curse of the Elements up all night and a parse over your usual
review.summary: 338 Curses of the Elements, and an average parse of 56 against your usual 45, with Patchwerk at 87. Noth hit you in melee at 1:11, before the explosions started, and Heigan's Spell Disruption at 2:40. 4 poison cloud hits on Grobbulus.

fix.title: Grobbulus
fix.text: 4 poison cloud hits.

fix.title: Noth
fix.text: Killed by Noth's melee at 1:11.

review.verdict: Pulled most of the trash all night and parsed 80+ on six bosses
review.summary: Your Arcane Shot opened most of the trash packs tonight. Parse 89 on Faerlina, 86 on Patchwerk, 85 on Gluth with three Tranquilizing Shots, 83 on Grobbulus, 82 on Maexxna, 81 on the Horsemen. Average 72, same as usual. On the Unholy weapons wipe your shot on the next Axe went out at 9.1 s, and three tenths of a second later an Unholy Swords nobody had touched was already hitting the healers: the shot wasn't the problem, but the two landed together. Holy Wrath got you on the Horsemen at 3:09.

good.title: Pulling
good.text: Opened most of the night's trash packs.

fix.title: Horsemen
fix.text: Holy Wrath at 3:09, together with Mohg and Bimlyqt.

review.verdict: Fourth on Anub'Rekhan, then nothing in the log
review.summary: Fourth on Anub'Rekhan at 1820/s. After that the log has you in the raid on Faerlina, Maexxna, Patchwerk and Gluth with no damage, and nothing after Gluth. If that was a disconnect, there's nothing to fix. Died on the spider trash at 19:43, the first death of that pack.

fix.title: No damage
fix.text: Zero damage on Faerlina, Maexxna, Patchwerk and Gluth.

review.summary: First on Faerlina (1943/s), second on Anub'Rekhan and Grobbulus, third on Razuvious and Loatheb, and a 93 tanking the Horsemen. Full tank consumables and three interrupts. Heigan got you at 1:38 with the other tanks, and Sapphiron's Blizzard at 6:56.

review.verdict: First on Thaddius and parse 97 on Faerlina
review.summary: First on Thaddius (2086/s), third on Faerlina with a 97, fifth on Patchwerk with a 94, fourth on the Horsemen and on Heigan. Average parse 66, a bit over your usual. Full consumables on every pull. Two boss deaths, both on fights where half the raid went with you: Heigan at 2:28 and the Sapphiron wipe.

review.verdict: First or second of the healers on nine bosses, and still standing after Heigan
review.summary: First of the healers on Faerlina, Maexxna and Gluth, second on Anub'Rekhan, Grobbulus, Thaddius, Gothik, Noth and Heigan. One of eight people alive at the end of Heigan. Your only boss death was the Sapphiron wipe at 5:24. The one gap is Patchwerk: last of 12 healers at 97 HPS with 88% overheal.

review.verdict: Controlled all four Worshippers on Faerlina, and dropped Razuvious at the same moment as Mornie
review.summary: Faerlina went perfectly on your side: all four Worshippers controlled. 11 Shackles, 19 dispels, one of eight alive after Heigan, and top five of the healers on Maexxna, Thaddius, the Horsemen and Heigan. Razuvious is the fix: your control ended at 0:47.0, half a second after Mornie's, and nobody held an Understudy until 1:03.9. Disrupting Shout hit 12 at 0:51.8 and killed you with them. Noth's explosions got you at 1:24.

good.title: Heigan
good.text: Alive at the end, one of eight, 7 Fevers cured.

fix.title: Razuvious controls
fix.text: Your control ended at 0:47.0, half a second after Mornie's, leaving 17 seconds with nobody holding an Understudy. Stagger the two, so one is always holding.

fix.title: Sapphiron
fix.text: Stood in the Blizzard twice.
